lina_sales: Quick handoff: Pelotonics (pilot). Signed 30-day dedicated trial. Main asks: SSO via Okta, VPC peering, reserve dedicated capacity (~2x A10s) to start, and a security review next week. Renewal risk: they need SOC2 evidence within 30d. Contract + notes in SF and drive. CC @jordan_cs for onboarding.

jordan_cs: Thanks @lina_sales — picking this up. I'll schedule kickoff and own the onboarding runbook. Who owns SSO metadata collection and Okta config? @ash_support for infra tickets?

ash_support: I'll create the infra ticket and loop eng for peering. Can you paste SF link and the customer contact? Also what's expected throughput (rps/tokens)?

lina_sales: Contact: Maya Chen (maya@pelotonics.io). PoC says ~200 req/min, typical responses ~120 tokens. SF case: https://salesforce.example.com/s/case/PEL-998 (internal). Contract: /drive/pelotonics/pilot-v1.pdf.

jordan_cs: Plan/checklist: 1) SSO config (Okta metadata) — owner @jordan_cs to collect 2) Infra ticket for VPC peering — owner @ash_support 3) Dedicated capacity request/provision — owner @miguel_eng 4) Eval prompt set + monitoring — owner @olivia_cs 5) Security docs (SOC2 ask) — owner @jordan_cs to escalate to security. Target kickoff: Thu 9am PT. I'll consolidate into a single ticket and tag owners.

miguel_eng: :wave I can reserve capacity but need sequence length distribution and latency SLO. Can we target p95 < 200ms? If latency is critical we should provision NVLink-enabled hosts rather than A10s.

olivia_cs: I'll start building the eval suite — need 10 representative prompts and success criteria (QA pass rate). Maya mentioned hallucination sensitivity on leaderboards.

ash_support: Infra ticket created: INF-4721. Added initial details and asked for peering CID ranges and contact info. Linking runbook: https://confluence.internal/infra/peering. Assigned to miguel_eng for capacity prep.

ops-bot: Automatic: kickoff meeting created Thu 2024-05-02 16:00 UTC. Meeting link: https://meet.example.com/abcd

jordan_cs: Great. @lina_sales can you DM Maya the kickoff invite and ask for Okta metadata + a technical contact? Also please flag the SOC2 timeline in the SF case sosecurity can triage.

lina_sales: On it. DM sent and SOC2 flag added to SF case. I told them to send Okta metadata and their network CID ranges before the kickoff.

ash_support: Noted. I'll keep INF-4721 updated and post any blocker notes here. If peering needs IP changes, estimate 24-48h lead time.

miguel_eng: I'll provision a staging cluster today and run a smoke test against a small sample workload. Will post results to INF-4721 when complete.

olivia_cs: I'll draft the prompt set by EOD tomorrow and share in this thread for feedback.

jordan_cs: Thanks team — next steps summarized in the ticket. Closing the handoff here; I'll ping if any blocker comes up before kickoff.
